fusions.name: Rolling Ram
fusions.desc: Curls up and rolls you up to 7 tiles into the target, dealing 13 damage, up to 1.6 times as much from the full 7 tiles.

fusions.name: Scale Flare
fusions.desc: Flares the edges of your scales, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and leaving them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Curl Tight
fusions.desc: Curls into your plates, gaining a barrier that absorbs the next 5 hits, up to 24 damage, for 6 seconds and raising your armour by 10%.

fusions.name: Shingled Back
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, another scale settles over you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
